tasks.label: Stop the running dev Memo
tasks.detail: Ends target/debug/memo before a (re)start, so cargo can replace the exe

args: $exe = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'src-tauri\target\debug\memo.exe'; Get-Process memo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $exe } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force; $_.WaitForExit(5000) | Out-Null }; exit 0
